prompts: Dimensional textbook physics diagram, white background navy labels teal light. Perspective coherent light source at left aimed toward metal barrier with TWO thin parallel vertical slits, detector screen right shows multiple vertical bright and dark interference fringes. After slits, transparent curved wavefronts spread from both openings and overlap before detector. Clear labels 'Coherent source', 'Two slits', 'Overlapping waves', 'Bright and dark bands'. No rays drawn as definite particle trajectories. Elegant realistic glass/metal materials and precise educational geometry, wide landscape.

Professional dimensional textbook illustration on white, navy labels, teal highlights. Heading 'Localized detections build an interference pattern'. Three framed detector screens side by side in perspective but faces readable: left exactly one small cyan detection dot on dark navy screen label 'One detection'; middle roughly20 randomly scattered small cyan dots label 'Few detections'; right thousands tiny distinct cyan dots concentrated into multiple vertical bright stripes with sparse dark gaps label 'Many detections'. No solid stripes: bands composed of discrete dots. Subtitle 'Both slits open; no which-path measurement'. Footer 'Individual outcomes are localized; many outcomes reveal the probability pattern'. Realistic softly shaded detector frames, no code-looking flat drawing.

Professional dimensional physics textbook comparison on white, navy labels, two side-by-side panels. Left realistic metal slab struck by incoming red photon indicated by red wavy arrow; NO electron leaves. label 'Below threshold' and 'Photon energy < work function'. Right similar metal slab incoming teal photon wavy arrow, a small amber electron sphere exits upward with arrow; label 'Above threshold' and 'Maximum electron kinetic energy = hf − φ'. Heading 'Photoelectric emission'. Explain in small footer 'At ordinary intensities, one photon transfers energy to one electron.' Show electrons inside metal schematically but no atomic orbital drawing. Crisp textbook polish, ample white space. No numerical energies.

Professional dimensional physics textbook illustration on white, navy labels. Two equal-size metal targets in side-by-side panels with identical teal photon beads approaching each target on parallel arrows. Left3 incident photon beads and3 amber emitted electron beads, right6 incident and6 emitted electron beads. All photons same color and size, emitted-electron arrows same length. Labels 'Lower intensity' and 'Higher intensity'. Heading 'More photons, same energy per photon'. Footer 'Fixed frequency above threshold: greater photon flux; unchanged maximum electron kinetic energy'. Realistic shaded metal surfaces and luminous spheres, clearly schematic counts, no wavy code-style curves, no numeric equations.

Professional dimensional optics textbook illustration, white background navy labels, two horizontal rows. Each row light travels left to right through two realistic circular polarizing sheets in metal ring holders. Incoming light marked unpolarized with electric-field arrows in varied transverse directions. First filter vertical transmission axis in both rows. After first filter vertical double-headed E arrows. TOP second filter also vertical labeled 'Parallel axes', light transmitted to right as vertical E arrows. BOTTOM second filter horizontal labeled 'Crossed axes (90°)', no light after second filter, small label 'Ideally no transmission'. Heading 'Polarization selects an electric-field direction'. Thin directional propagation arrows horizontal, clearly distinguish from transverse E vectors. No impossible bends or longitudinal E arrows. Softly shaded glass and stands, educational schematic.

Professional dimensional astronomy textbook diagram on white with navy labels and realistic small telescope bottom left and receding star bottom right. Main area two aligned horizontal wavelength rulers, each from490nm to515nm with ticks490 495 500 505 510 515 evenly spaced. Top labeled 'Rest spectrum' single narrow teal line at500, label '500 nm'. Bottom labeled 'Observed spectrum' narrow line at505, label '505 nm'. Rightward arrow between line positions labeled '+5 nm'. Axis caption 'Wavelength increases →'. Bottom telescope looks toward distant star, star movement arrow points away from telescope to right, label 'Receding source'. Footer 'z = (505 − 500)/500 = 0.010' and 'At low speed: vᵣ ≈ cz = 3,000 km/s'. Accurate spectral schematic, subtle dimensional frames and instrument, no full rainbow needed.

Correct slit geometry only: the two vertical slit openings must be SIDE BY SIDE horizontally, equal height, NOT stacked vertically. Keep two overlapping wavefront families emerging from those two side-by-side vertical slits and vertical interference fringes on screen. Preserve professional dimensional source, barrier, screen and labels.

Scientific educational professional dimensional textbook infographic on white navy labels. Three horizontal rows ALPHA, BETA-MINUS, GAMMA. Shaded nuclei made of red protons and blue neutrons schematic (not exact counts except alpha cluster). Alpha: large parent nucleus arrow to slightly smaller daughter nucleus plus separate emitted alpha cluster of EXACTLY TWO red and TWO blue spheres. Caption 'A decreases by 4; Z decreases by 2'. Beta-minus: close-up blue neutron transforms via arrow into red proton plus small gold electron labeled e⁻ and faint tiny dot labeled electron antineutrino. Caption 'A unchanged; Z increases by 1'. Gamma: identical nucleus before and after with exactly same arrangement of colored spheres, left excited glow, right emits purple wavy photon arrow outward. Caption 'A and Z unchanged; excitation energy decreases'. Heading 'Three kinds of radioactive decay'. Legend proton red neutron blue. Elegant scientific dimensional rendering; accurate symbols and no orbital electrons.

Professional dimensional textbook educational diagram on white. Four clear sample trays arranged left-to-right, each with EIGHT identical-sized glossy spheres in exact2x4 arrangement. First8teal parent spheres, second4teal+4gray daughter spheres, third2teal+6gray, fourth1teal+7gray. All trays keep8total spheres. Navy headings0h,6h,12h,18h. Beneath each respective tray '80 mg parent','40 mg parent','20 mg parent','10 mg parent'. Arrows between trays labeled '6 hours'. Main title 'Half-life: parent nuclei transform'. Legend teal 'Parent isotope', gray 'Decay products (schematic)'. Footer 'Expected parent amount halves every 6 hours. Individual decay times are unpredictable.' Soft realistic dimensional shading, readable navy typography, no disappearance of total sample.

Professional dimensional scientific textbook diagram on white with navy text. Two large labeled sample nuclei side by side represented as softly shaded clusters; explicit caption 'Nuclei shown schematically'. LEFT 'Carbon-12', '6 protons + 6 neutrons', 'A = 12, Z = 6', 'Stable'. RIGHT 'Carbon-14', '6 protons + 8 neutrons', 'A = 14, Z = 6', 'Radioactive'. Red proton spheres blue neutron spheres in clusters, use exact12 and14 if possible, no orbitals. Footer 'Same element: equal proton count. Different isotope: different neutron count.' Elegant dimensional textures and readable concise labels.

Professional dimensional nuclear physics textbook diagram white background navy labels. Left incoming blue neutron arrow strikes schematic heavy nucleus labeled 'Uranium-235'. Middle excited deformed nucleus labeled 'Uranium-236*'. Right branches to two distinct large fragment clusters labeled 'Barium-141 (Z = 56)' and 'Krypton-92 (Z = 36)' plus EXACTLY THREE separate blue neutron spheres with outward arrows and label '3 neutrons'. Protons red, neutrons blue. Above title 'One possible fission of uranium-235'. Below equations '235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3' and '92 = 56 + 36'. Footer 'Kinetic energy and radiation carry released energy'. Nucleus clusters schematic do not try 235 individual spheres. Polished dimensional shading not code-looking.

Professional dimensional nuclear physics textbook illustration white background navy labels, three horizontal reaction rows with glossy red proton and blue neutron spheres, gold positron tiny sphere, neutrino small teal dot, gamma wavy arrow. Heading 'The Sun: a proton–proton chain'. Row1: two separate red proton spheres arrow to deuterium cluster exactly1red1blue + positron labeled e⁺ + electron neutrino labeled νₑ; label '1. Form deuterium'. Row2 deuterium1red1blue + red proton arrow to helium-3 cluster2red1blue + gamma photon; label '2. Form helium-3'. Row3 two helium-3 clusters each2red1blue arrow to helium-4 cluster2red2blue + two separate red proton spheres; label '3. Form helium-4'. Note 'Steps 1 and 2 occur twice before step 3.' Footer 'Overall: four protons are used to form helium-4; positrons, neutrinos and energy are released.' Proton red neutron blue legend. Accurate countable spheres, ample spacing no extra nucleons.

Professional dimensional textbook scientific comparison on white navy labels. Two panels. Left 'Steady chain reaction' shows three realistic schematic heavy nucleus clusters in a single horizontal sequence connected by ONE neutron arrow each; side branches end absorbed in charcoal control rod or escape away. Caption 'Average: 1 further fission per fission'. Right 'Growing chain reaction' shows one nucleus leading to two next nuclei, each leading to two more, tree of glossy nuclear clusters and thin blue neutron arrows. Caption 'Average: more than 1 further fission per fission'. Footer 'Control rods absorb neutrons. Moderators slow neutrons.' No bombs, explosions, reactor construction details. Clearly conceptual schematic, realistic shaded clusters and rod, precise readable science illustration.

Professional dimensional textbook infographic white navy labels. Heading 'Half-life predicts populations'. Upper row three glass trays filled with many glossy schematic spheres, teal parent and gray decay products. Clearly printed cards under trays: 'Start: 100 parents', '1 half-life: 50 expected', '2 half-lives: 25 expected'. Do not attempt countable individual exact100, explicitly label 'Particle drawings are schematic'. Lower row four realistic small sample vials labeled 'Run 1: 12 remain', 'Run 2: 8 remain', 'Run 3: 11 remain', 'Run 4: 9 remain'. Section heading 'Each run starts with 20; after one half-life'. Footer 'Expected: 10 remain. Actual small samples fluctuate.' No graph, no contradictory quantities, dimensional objects with professional typography.

Professional dimensional physics textbook infographic on white navy labels. Two side-by-side polished metal balance pans without a misleading balance beam. Left schematic nuclear reactants cluster caption 'Initial total rest mass'. Right schematic nuclear products cluster plus outward golden energy arrows caption 'Lower total product rest mass + released energy'. Center rightward arrow 'Nuclear reaction'. Prominent formula 'E = Δmc²'. Optional numeric example below '0.0200 u × 931.5 MeV/u = 18.6 MeV'. Footer 'Total mass-energy is conserved'. Stylish realistic shaded glossy nuclear clusters, red blue nucleons, gold energy, exact text no mass disappearing.

Professional dimensional textbook schematic of a nuclear power plant with separate steam loop, white background navy labels. Left cutaway reactor vessel with fuel core and label '1. Fission heats fuel'. Beside it closed primary coolant loop shown as red hot pipe from reactor into heat exchanger and blue cooler return pipe to reactor. Label '2. Coolant transfers heat'. Heat exchanger middle has coil separating primary coolant from secondary water, clear label '3. Heat exchanger: fluids do not mix'. Secondary closed loop: steam pipe from heat exchanger top to realistically shaded turbine at right, shaft from turbine to generator further right; labels '4. Steam turns turbine', '5. Generator supplies electricity'. Return from turbine through condenser below then liquid return to heat exchanger. Label condenser 'Heat to surroundings'. No connection mixing primary and secondary fluids. Clean understandable broad conceptual illustration, no reactor engineering specifications, no cooling tower needed, accurate energy conversion chain. Wide landscape detailed but not crowded.

Professional dimensional textbook quantum optics diagram on white navy labels. Two separate panels above. Left 'Absorption': two horizontal energy levels lower E₁ and upper E₂, electron gold sphere on lower level, UPWARD arrow to upper, incoming teal photon wavy arrow labeled 'hf = E₂ − E₁'. Right 'Emission': same two levels, electron upper, DOWNWARD arrow to lower, outgoing teal photon wavy arrow same label. Below realistic shaded optical spectrometer and two dark spectral strips with several distinct thin colored emission lines, labels 'Laboratory reference' and 'Matching pattern from source', identical relative pattern. Footer 'Allowed energy differences produce characteristic spectral lines.' No planetary orbit model, no claim one line identifies element, polished dimensional instrument and electron spheres, precise arrow direction.

Professional dimensional astronomy textbook diagram white navy labels. Two tidy matching cards in dimensional silver frames. Left card 'Line 1': rest500nm arrow observed505nm, small label '+5 nm'. Right card 'Line 2': rest600nm arrow observed606nm, small label '+6 nm'. All text large. Small realistic telescope below left looking toward softly glowing distant star right. Main heading 'Same fractional shift, different absolute shifts'. Formula beneath cards '505/500 = 606/600 = 1.010'. Footer 'z = 0.010 for both lines'. No continuous wavelength scale, no contradictory color coding, no other numerical values. Precise professional educational illustration.

Professional dimensional physics textbook diagram, TOP-DOWN schematic perspective on white. Metal barrier is a vertical narrow strip in the IMAGE at x35%, separating left incident region and right propagation region. It has TWO small gaps at y35% and y65%. Straight parallel incident wavefront lines from left. After barrier draw two families of concentric SEMICIRCULAR wavefronts opening to the right, centered EXACTLY at the two gaps respectively, overlapping toward detector vertical strip at x88%. Detector shows alternating bright/dark intensity spots ALONG ITS VERTICAL HEIGHT in this top-down cross section. Label 'Top view', 'Two slit openings (cross-section)', 'Overlapping wavefronts', 'Detector'. Slight dimensional shaded metal barrier and detector housings, crisp teal wavefronts, navy labels. No face-on vertical fringe screen. Accurate wavefront centers crucial.

Professional dimensional astronomy textbook cutaway illustration of the Sun on pure white, navy labels. Large realistic sphere with wedge cutaway reveals central core, radiative zone surrounding core, convection zone outside, thin photosphere surface. Accurate layer ordering. Label core 'Fusion supplies energy'; radiative zone 'Repeated absorption, emission and scattering'; convection zone 'Moving plasma transports energy'; photosphere 'Light escapes'. Small straight faint teal neutrino arrows from core through outer layers labeled 'Neutrinos escape readily'. Radiation path in radiative zone is zigzag short segments, convection zone circular circulation arrows, no straight visible photon from core. To right small realistically shaded telescope receives rays from surface, below a continuous rainbow spectrum with thin dark absorption lines labeled 'Absorption lines form in cooler gas'. Heading 'From core fusion to observed sunlight'. Schematic paths not to scale; educational publisher-quality dimensional rendering.

revisions.instruction: Replace overlapping nuclei with separated countable arrays: carbon-12 has six red protons and six blue neutrons; carbon-14 has six red protons and eight blue neutrons. Preserve labels.
Change all spectral marks to neutral teal and background to white; preserve every number and label.

Use a generic energy ledger without isotope labels. Equal total-height columns represent initial rest-mass energy and product rest-mass energy plus released energy. E = Δmc². Hypothetical example: 0.0200 u × 931.5 MeV/u = 18.6 MeV.
